import numpy as np
def tangents(lo, hi, M):
    p = np.linspace(lo, hi, M)
    return np.vstack([1.0 / (1.0 + p), np.log1p(p) - p / (1.0 + p)])
def instance(n, N):
    i = np.arange(n)
    j = np.arange(N)
    xmin = -(150 + (37 * i) % 121) / 1000.0
    xmax = (120 + (53 * i) % 101) / 1000.0
    X = (((7 * j[:, None] + 13 * i[None, :] + 5 * j[:, None] * i[None, :]) % 181) - 90) / 1000.0
    return xmin, xmax, X
xmin, xmax, X = instance(1000, 25)
coeffs = tangents(-0.26444, 0.21543, 9)
radius = 0.05
held = np.arange(0, 1000, 5)
raw = 1.0 + ((held * 37) % 101) / 101.0
w = np.zeros(1000)
w[held] = raw / raw.sum()
assert np.allclose(surrogate_worst_case(w.copy(), xmin.copy(), xmax.copy(), X.copy(), coeffs.copy(), radius), target)
